trails.name: Sunset Ridge trail
trails.description: A gentle loop trail with wide views of the Valley and a beautiful sunset lookout point.

trails.name: Bear Canyon Loop
trails.description: A scenic forested loop with creek crossings, shaded paths, and great wildlife viewing.

trails.name: Eagle Peak Summit
trails.description: A challenging climb to a panoramic summit with sweeping viewa of the Wasatch Front.

trails.name: Maple Hollow Trail
trails.description: A popular trail with shaded switchbacks and a rewarding overlook at the top.

trails.name: Hidden Falls Trail
trails.description: A short family-friendly trail leading to a beautiful waterfall tucked into the canyon.

trails.name: Lone Peak Trail
trails.description: A strenuous all-day hike to one of the most iconic granite peaks in Utah.

trails.name: Desolation Lake Trail
trails.description: A scenic alpine trail leading to a peaceful lake surrounded by pines and rugged ridgelines.

trails.name: Mount Timpanogos Summit
trails.description: One of Utah's most iconic hikes, offering wildflowers, wild life, and a breathtaking summit view.

trails.name: Donut Falls Trail
trails.description: A family-friendly trail leading to a unique waterfall that pours through a natural rock hole.

trails.name: Angels Landing (to Scout Lookout)
trails.description: A steep, dramatic climb to Scout Lookout with stunning canyon views. Chains section not included.

trails.name: Navajo Loop Trail
trails.description: A short but unforgettable loop through hoodoos, slot-like passages, and Bryce’s iconic orange cliffs.

trails.name: Cecret Lake Trail
trails.description: A gentle alpine trail leading to a crystal-clear lake surrounded by wildflowers and granite peaks.

trails.name: Fisher Towers Trail
trails.description: A dramatic desert trail weaving between towering red rock spires and sweeping canyon views.

trails.name: Red Pine Lake Trail
trails.description: A challenging alpine climb to a stunning glacial lake nestled beneath rugged granite peaks.

trails.name: Corona Arch Trail
trails.description: A fun desert hike featuring ladders, slickrock, and one of Utah’s most impressive natural arches.
